findings.observation: Observed: neither the upstream repository root nor qq-speed contains a LICENSE/NOTICE file at the pinned revision; the package declares ISC but has an empty author field. The exact attempt-10 workspace contains only game/LICENSE.three.txt among license/notice-named files; its final H5 embeds the Three.js MIT notice, but no ISC copyright/permission notice. The standard ISC text requires a copyright owner/year and says copies must include the copyright and permission notices. Inference: ISC is a declaration for package software if made by an authorized rights holder; it does not establish rights to third-party characters, marks, or map expression. Do not conclude that package ISC alone clears all assets.
